nodes.description: address public owner - privileged account set in Ownable/EthTeamContract constructor
mapping(address=>uint256) internal balances_ - token balance bookkeeping
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) internal allowed_ - ERC20 allowance bookkeeping
uint256 internal totalSupply_ - mutable total token supply (starts at 0)
string public name - token name
string public symbol - token symbol
uint8 public decimals - token decimals (3)
uint256 public price - token price in wei, recalculated from balance/totalSupply_
uint8 public status - 0 = tradable, 1 = frozen; gates buy and sell paths
uint64 public gameTime - game start timestamp used for time based gating
uint64 public finishTime - timestamp after which owner can sweep the balance
address public feeOwner - recipient of ETH fees and of the final balance sweep
address public gameOpponent - opposing EthTeamContract, target of cross-contract calls
transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner - reassigns owner
totalSupply() view - returns totalSupply_
balanceOf(address _owner) view - returns balances_[_owner]
allowance(address _owner,address _spender) view - returns allowed_ entry
EthTeamContract.transfer(address _to,uint256 _value) - overrides ERC20 transfer; if _to == address(this) performs a SELL and sends ETH to msg.sender
transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint256 _value) - allowance based transfer
approve(address _spender,uint256 _value) - sets allowed_ allowance
EthTeamContract constructor - initializes token metadata, price, game parameters and owner
function() payable - BUY path: mints tokens to msg.sender based on msg.value/price
changeStatus(uint8 _status) onlyOwner - toggles tradable/frozen status
finish() onlyOwner - after finishTime, forwards the whole contract balance to feeOwner
beginGame(address _gameOpponent,uint64 _gameTime) onlyOwner - initializes opponent, time and status
endGame(address _gameOpponent,uint8 _gameResult) onlyOwner - settles the match, moves ETH between teams, pays the fee, recalculates price
endGameInternal() private - resets gameOpponent, gameTime and status
transferFundAndEndGame() payable - called by the opponent contract, accepts ETH, recalculates price and resets state
msg.sender - caller controlled address used for balances, allowances and ownership checks

op.transferFundAndEndGame() - external call into the opponent EthTeamContract with no value
